user_rule: The goal is to assess the automatic pipeline, not pipeline plus Codex. Manual assessment after completion is allowed; manual fixing is not.
generation_allowed: Existing pipeline implementation at a pinned revision
Frozen declared input collection, repository configuration and free-GLM settings
Pipeline-owned bounded automatic repair loops without task-specific external feedback
Generic authenticated transport, deadlines, accounting, preservation and cleanup
generation_disallowed: Task-specific Codex edits to instructions, learner source, reference solution, tests, verifier or runtime assets
Task-specific Codex feedback to the model, including native repair calls seeded with that feedback
Replacing a failed automatic output with an assisted repaired version in the primary yield
assessment_allowed: Read original final pipeline outputs and compare them with source/test contracts
Report quality, errors, limitations and accept/reject judgments after completion
Run read-only or separate-copy diagnostic controls without changing the published task or feeding outcomes back into generation
historical_policy: Preserve the 30 previously accepted/scored records as legacy mixed-provenance evidence. Manual review alone is allowed and is not an exclusion. Primary automatic-output eligibility requires provenance checks; an assisted recovery never overwrites the original failure or resets the original candidate cap.
candidate_limits: Retain original target 3 and cap10 per declared cell/cohort; consumed and uncertain candidates stay consumed.
execution_authorization: User resumed within existing free-GLM/CPU resource and $2000 campaign limits; no budget expansion.
success_claims: The main comparison is the original automatic pipeline under its frozen declared configuration, including its native bounded repair loops.
Codex-assisted historical recoveries stay outside automatic success counts.
Unchanged content with modified runtime is reported separately from unchanged content and runtime.
A reusable integration change may be assessed as a separately declared variant; it cannot retroactively turn the original failure into success.
Manual final assessment can accept or reject an output without repairing it.
